notes: All 10 snapshot text files across 6 pages were readable; no live copies were in the chunk. All copies are Common Crawl captures, so sourceUrl is the index lookup address from each footer and sourceDate is the capture timestamp's date. (1) doctoral/candidates.aspx (2013-05-24): 10 job-market candidates with program, minor and dissertation title; no year on the page (listedYear null, yearMeaning job-market). (2) M&O PhD alumni page (2013-12-08, 2014-11-28): 'Recent Graduates' rows are written as "Name 'YY, Institution" in two table columns (SM&E / OB/HR); the plain-text copy flattens the columns, so column membership was taken from the saved .html of the same snapshot. The class year 'YY is recorded as listedYear with yearMeaning graduation (heading 'Recent Graduates'); the destination is the institution as listed and is not stated to be the first job. 'Select Alumni of M&O' names have no year (listedYear null, yearMeaning unstated) and list current affiliations, many of them long-serving faculty (e.g. Ming-Jer Chen, Carl Zeithaml), so their destination is not a first placement; Jay Carson appears in both lists. (3) M&O PhD candidates page: heading 'PhD Candidates 2014' (listedYear 2014, job-market) and 'PhD Candidates 2014-15' (recorded as 2015, range quoted in note); names only, column membership from the .html. Beth Campbell-Bush (candidates 2013-12) appears as Beth Campbell on the 2014 alumni list. (4) Research Dissertations page (2014-11-28): 21 completed dissertations with program abbreviation and chair; no year on the page (listedYear null, yearMeaning unstated). (5) Job Market Candidates page (2013-12-12, 2014-11-23, 2019-02-18): tables with name, program/field, job-market paper and advisor(s); no year on the page (listedYear null, job-market).
